phone.author: smallbigsquare
phone.adaptation: Original geometry scaled uniformly; existing palette recolored cream front and lavender side/back, call screen overlaid

pose.type: floating handheld, without visible hand or support

room_layout.placement: Mesh bounds centred and grounded; bed/desk/cupboard against walls
room_layout.photo_camera_target: Near phone, left 45 degrees, camera at desk height (0.837m)

photo_motion_reference.implementation: One 3D paper changes both front/reverse to room at the final edge-on pass; outside the paper is plain warm colour with falling CG cards; no distant room or gate image backdrop
photo_motion_reference.centre_fall_path: Cubic Bezier bowed fall, with lateral and depth movement
photo_motion_reference.centre_fall_easing: OutCubic: faster then slower, with a small absolute movement
photo_motion_reference.spin_easing: Asymmetric InSine/OutSine: 28% acceleration, 72% deceleration; continuous velocity
photo_motion_reference.room_print_switch: Last edge-on pass at 270 degrees, approx 1.42721s, so the front is room before the turn settles
photo_motion_reference.axis_ring_decor: Single fine pale line, 32% opacity, subtle small bead and gradual reveal/fade; no ticks, stars, dashed outer ring or scale bounce
photo_motion_reference.spin_emission: 36 particles and 18 short line rays launch from the 3D paper edges, travel outward with OutQuad, fade and shrink; local birth range 0.76-1.442s
photo_motion_reference.photo_entry_path: Cubic Bezier spatial path; InOutSine time easing; starts 0.25s before rotation finishes

screen.source: ${GAME_ROOT}\解包\其他图片\效果\恋発信中.png
screen.adaptation: Recomposed cream/lavender call UI: upper portrait, centred name/status, three round function keys, separate full coral hang-up button

phone_camera.easing: OutSine: diagonal descending right arc, moving inward toward the call phone while SMS descends
phone_camera.target: Brief room glance in the middle, then centre on the call screen near desk height; camera descends 0.22m

sms.source: ${GAME_ROOT}\解包\其他图片\效果\恋メール.png
sms.screen: Recomposed blue sending UI, matched to call-screen resolution 618x1195
sms.model: Same public CC0 Smartphone, foreground true-3D render with transparency
sms.easing: 0.20-second rapid Hermite entry, speed-matched to a 0.85-second OutQuad deceleration from the lower-quarter screen boundary
sms.coverage: Left half, screen faces camera and handset top points upper-right
sms.silhouette: Instant white phone on protagonist blue #3e69a0

character.generation: bundled imagegen CLI masked edit; gpt-image-2; high; natural continuous wrist and plain sleeve
character.pose: forward grip; grouped rounded fingers, short thumb, smooth wrist joining plain sleeve

styles.simple: white upper-body and hand, sparse pale-blue cup/thumb/wrist marks; no outlined cuff band
styles.detail: local comparison option only; selected final is simple

character.framing: head to waist only; legs never included
character.postprocess: v8 coherent alpha, all body linework removed; isolated cup/hand marks 70 percent, median 3px; dark-blue shadow 60 percent, blur 5px, offset [20,16]px

silhouette_call.phone_outline: screen frame, speaker and home contour appear fully at local 4.95; only envelope has drawing animation
silhouette_call.flight_easing: 74 percent InCubic, 26 percent OutCubic; actual arrival song65.100 after front compression
silhouette_call.wave_shape: two short glints, alpha 0.22, width 3px; smooth 25px/s drift and 32px/s radius growth after reception, exponential fade 0.72 per second through shot end; no freeze
silhouette_call.motion_blur: 22 temporal samples over 22ms plus soft stroke bands; speed dependent
silhouette_call.ripples: 8 travel emissions plus 3 reception births at local 6.22/6.34/6.46; reception lifetime 1.40s, two layers, OutSine spread to 860px and continuous fade; no time clamp
silhouette_call.impact_easing: sin squared; zero-speed endpoints, slow single return
silhouette_call.camera_easing: InOutCubic follow with early catch-up; 4px sin-squared return; replaced by right whip at actual song65.400

timing_retime.local_seconds_basis: Existing photo_print, phone_camera, sms and silhouette_call fields retain nominal phase seconds; laser_transition song seconds are actual

impact_shock.scope: Outgoing scene only; incoming puppet CG is stable

laser_transition.plane: Behind character, enlarged cast shadow offset100/36px clipped to beam
laser_transition.whip_easing: InCubic outgoing acceleration, OutCubic incoming settle
laser_transition.incoming_cg: CGC14_a; existing body/hand rig, independent RGBA hair mesh and fixed-iris eyelids; blink after arrival

incoming_override.content: CGC06 closed/o right-hand camera; replaces CGC14 placeholder
incoming_override.motion: Shared cgc06-motion.gd; linear preroll meets matched fast entry, early smooth braking and continuous visible slow pan at 66.000
incoming_override.atmosphere: Shared atmosphere.gd: source-space background field with character exclusion plus five sparse closeup foreground particles across hands/clothing/background; screen-fixed Eagle white frame; same song time and 65.670–65.910 reveal
